name: prefixquant_w4a4_int8_storage
notes: Replaces fake-quant fp16 W4A4 (2650 tok/s, 18.5 GB) with 4-bit codes stored in int8 and the shared w8a8_int8 Triton GEMM (exact for 4-bit codes): 6588 tok/s, 12.0 GB, same PPL. Pieces in the port overlay.patch: quantize/int_linear_packed.py (fused RMSNorm + per-token A4 quant with learned clip, per-token A4 quant for o_proj/down_proj inputs incl. looped K=12288 with cached had_K, group-wise KV4 fake quant; bit-exact vs the repo quantizers), utils/packed_runtime.py (convert fake-quant artifact to int8 codes + fp16 per-channel scales with a bit-exact check, meta-device loader, prefix-aware flash SDPA that front-pads the query by the prefix length). int4 two-per-byte storage was exact but 5-25% slower per GEMM at M=2048, so int8 storage is kept. Remaining prefill hot spots: fp16 lm_head (37 ms) and the 12x12 Hadamard bmm on the down_proj input (~8 ms). Not vLLM-servable (A4).
